1116-1829-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-1829-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4078-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-5931.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Funeral Room triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

339-677-4247-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6132-6981-8095.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

240-1879-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-1879-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

757-5087-5101-7798.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-5087-5101-7798.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Merfolk Skydiver to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Natural Emergence, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

618-3305-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

872-5621-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-3301-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

2604-3532-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4377-5531-7068.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4377-5531-7068.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Baboon Spirit.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

3967-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3967-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3519-4742-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3519-4742-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate a Forest Dryad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 3 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

1144-2645-5234-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

277-2404-6507-7115.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
277-2404-6507-7115.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
277-2404-6507-7115.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing a land that wasn't tapped for mana in step 1.
Toph's second ability triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending another land you control.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing the land that was earthbent in step 6.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning the sacrificed land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land that entered by tapping it adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.
277-2404-6507-7115.notes: If the other land that is recurred doesn't produce mana, you must control four or more creatures for the combo to function.

338-360-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-360-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-413-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Presumed Dead triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

141-5686-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5686-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2647-3976-6350.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2647-3976-6350.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Warrior's Oath and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Glorious End and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Warrior's Oath and Glorious End noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Warrior's Oath without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Glorious End without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Warrior's Oath trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

659-4381-4613-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-6791.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

104-2741-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2741-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-4659-4986-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2615-4927-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-4927-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

478-539-5457--111.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.

1849-2457-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4444-4772-5742-5743.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3812-4137-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3812-4137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Blossom-Clad Werewolf's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-804-2416-2821-6071.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2416-2821-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-804-2416-2821-6071.description:
Animate Candelabra using Rise and Shine
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and The Core.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

643-1238-2351-4050-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

2800-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2800-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2800-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

4365-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4365-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

725-3143-4762.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
Aura of Dominion attached to Xavier Sal.
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Devoted Druid and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
725-3143-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Devoted Druid, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the creature token, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

86-3489-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Mistblade Shinobi does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
86-3489-3821.description:
Declare Mistblade Shinobi as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Peregrine Drake's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Mistblade Shinobi from the battlefield to your hand, putting Peregrine Drake onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Mistblade Shinobi's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mistblade Shinobi onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

630-2645-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five in any combination of Forests, Mountains and/or Plains.
630-2645-4657.description:
Activate five in any combination of Forests, Mountains and Plains by tapping them, adding {5}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping the five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1164-2056-2575-4243.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli has at least three loyalty counters.
1164-2056-2575-4243.description:
Cast Temporal Mastery by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Temporal Mastery, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing the Servo to become a copy of Mirror of Fate until end of turn.
Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Temporal Mastery and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Temporal Mastery being the top most card.
If Saheeli has less than three loyalty counters on it, activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling Saheeli until your next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, if you activated Venser's ability, Venser triggers, returning Saheeli from exile to the battlefield.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Mastery during your draw step.
Repeat.

15-803-1722-2034.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
15-803-1722-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Laid to Rest triggers, drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, paying {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1719-3664-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3664-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
